description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack, dealing Havoc DMG. Hitting a target with at least 100 Imagination sends Roccia into mid-air and activates the Beyond Imagination state. The longer you hold the Basic Attack button, the more Imagination Roccia gains. In this state, Roccia can continue to charge the attack even when her STA depletes. Heavy Attack will be automatically cast when you release the Basic Attack button while charging or when Imagination reaches the max limit.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang, memberikan Havoc DMG. Mengenai target dengan minimal 100 Imagination membawa Roccia ke udara dan mengaktifkan kondisi Beyond Imagination. Semakin lama tombol Basic Attack ditahan, semakin banyak Imagination yang didapat Roccia. Dalam kondisi ini, Roccia dapat terus mengisi serangan bahkan saat STA-nya habis. Heavy Attack akan otomatis dilancarkan saat tombol Basic Attack dilepas selama pengisian atau saat Imagination mencapai batas maksimum.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

attributes.name: STA Cost per Second while Charging

description.en: Roccia projects her creativity into reality, pulling in nearby targets and dealing Havoc DMG. She then launches into mid-air and activates the Beyond Imagination state.
description.id: Roccia mewujudkan kreativitasnya menjadi kenyataan, menarik target di sekitar dan memberikan Havoc DMG. Ia kemudian meluncur ke udara dan mengaktifkan kondisi Beyond Imagination.

description.en: Roccia's improvised comedy begins! Deal Havoc DMG to the target, considered Heavy Attack DMG. For every 0.1% of Roccia's Crit. Rate over 50%, this skill increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 1 points for 30s, up to 200 points.
description.id: Komedi improvisasi Roccia dimulai! Memberikan Havoc DMG ke target, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG. Untuk setiap 0,1% Crit. Rate Roccia di atas 50%, skill ini meningkatkan ATK semua Resonator di tim sebesar 1 poin selama 30 dtk, hingga 200 poin.

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill or Heavy Attack increases Roccia's ATK by 20% for 12s.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Skill atau Heavy Attack meningkatkan ATK Roccia sebesar 20% selama 12 dtk.

description.en:
After casting Outro Skill, the Utility of the incoming Resonator is replaced with Magic Box.

Magic Box

- Upon use, pull nearby targets toward the Magic Box, dealing 100 points of Havoc DMG. This skill is considered Echo Skill that deals Utility DMG.
- The Magic Box lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.
description.id:
Setelah melancarkan Outro Skill, Utility Resonator yang masuk digantikan oleh Magic Box.

Magic Box

- Saat digunakan, menarik target di sekitar ke arah Magic Box, memberikan 100 poin Havoc DMG. Skill ini dianggap Echo Skill yang memberikan Utility DMG.
- Magic Box bertahan selama 14 dtk atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG. Use Basic Attack right after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.
description.id: Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG. Gunakan Basic Attack tepat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 4.

description.en:
Beyond Imagination

- When Roccia is in Beyond Imagination with at least 100 Imagination, press the Basic Attack button to consume 100 Imagination to cast Basic Attack Real Fantasy.
- Roccia exits this state when she is not airborne or when switched off the field.

Basic Attack - Real Fantasy

- Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When Roccia lands after Stage 1 and Stage 2 attacks with over 100 Imagination, she will launch into mid-air and activate Beyond Imagination.

Imagination

Roccia can hold up to 300 Imagination.
- Dealing DMG with Normal Attacks restores Imagination.
- Hold Normal Attack to charge the next attack while restoring Imagination.
- Casting Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick restores 100 Imagination.
- Casting Intro Skill Pero, Help restores 100 Imagination.
description.id:
Beyond Imagination

- Saat Roccia dalam Beyond Imagination dengan minimal 100 Imagination, tekan tombol Basic Attack untuk mengonsumsi 100 Imagination dan melancarkan Basic Attack Real Fantasy.
- Roccia keluar dari kondisi ini saat tidak berada di udara atau saat diganti keluar dari lapangan.

Basic Attack - Real Fantasy

- Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG. Saat Roccia mendarat setelah serangan Tahap 1 dan Tahap 2 dengan lebih dari 100 Imagination, ia akan meluncur ke udara dan mengaktifkan Beyond Imagination.

Imagination

Roccia dapat menyimpan hingga 300 Imagination.
- Memberikan DMG dengan Normal Attack memulihkan Imagination.
- Tahan Normal Attack untuk mengisi serangan berikutnya sambil memulihkan Imagination.
- Melancarkan Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick memulihkan 100 Imagination.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill Pero, Help memulihkan 100 Imagination.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Memiliki peluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Havoc DMG Amplified by 20% and Basic Attack DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.
description.id: Resonator yang masuk mendapat Amplify Havoc DMG sebesar 20% dan Amplify Basic Attack DMG sebesar 25% selama 14 dtk atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
Casting Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick grants 100 additional Imagination and 10 Concerto Energy.
Immune to interruptions when casting Basic Attack Real Fantasy
description.id:
Melancarkan Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick memberikan 100 Imagination tambahan dan 10 Concerto Energy.
Kebal terhadap interupsi saat melancarkan Basic Attack Real Fantasy

description.en: Casting Basic Attack Real Fantasy grants all Resonators in the team 10% Havoc DMG Bonus for 30s, stacking up to 3 time. Upon reaching the max stacks, it grants all Resonators in the team 10% additional Havoc DMG Bonus for 30s.
description.id: Melancarkan Basic Attack Real Fantasy memberi semua Resonator di tim 10% Havoc DMG Bonus selama 30 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 3 kali. Setelah mencapai stack maksimum, semua Resonator di tim mendapat tambahan 10% Havoc DMG Bonus selama 30 dtk.

sequences.name: When the Heart Sees and Hands Feel

description.en: Casting Intro Skill Pero, Help increases Roccia's Crit. Rate by 10% and Crit. DMG by 30% for 15s.
description.id: Melancarkan Intro Skill Pero, Help meningkatkan Crit. Rate Roccia sebesar 10% dan Crit. DMG sebesar 30% selama 15 dtk.

sequences.name: When Wonders Gather in the Box

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick increases Basic Attack Real Fantasy's DMG Multiplier by 60% for 12s.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick meningkatkan pengali DMG Basic Attack Real Fantasy sebesar 60% selama 12 dtk.

sequences.name: When Dreams Are Reborn on Stage

description.en: Increase Resonance Liberation Commedia Improvviso!'s DMG Multiplier by 20% and Heavy Attack's DMG Multiplier by 80%.
description.id: Meningkatkan pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Commedia Improvviso! sebesar 20% dan pengali DMG Heavy Attack sebesar 80%.

description.en:
Casting Resonance Liberation Commedia Improvviso! grants the following effects for 12s:
- Basic Attack Real Fantasy ignores enemies' DEF by 60%.
- When Roccia lands after performing Basic Attack Real Fantasy Stage 3, she is launched into mid-air, activating Beyond Imagination. In this state, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Reality Recreation, dealing DMG equal to 100% of Basic Attack Real Fantasy Stage 3 DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Roccia is immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack Reality Recreation.
- When Roccia lands after performing Basic Attack Reality Recreation, she is launched into mid-air, activating Beyond Imagination. Basic Attack Reality Recreation is only available in the Beyond Imagination state.
description.id:
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Commedia Improvviso! memberikan efek berikut selama 12 dtk:
- Basic Attack Real Fantasy mengabaikan 60% DEF musuh.
- Saat Roccia mendarat setelah melakukan Basic Attack Real Fantasy Tahap 3, ia meluncur ke udara dan mengaktifkan Beyond Imagination. Dalam kondisi ini, Basic Attack menjadi Basic Attack Reality Recreation, memberikan DMG sebesar 100% DMG Basic Attack Real Fantasy Tahap 3, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG. Roccia kebal terhadap interupsi saat melancarkan Basic Attack Reality Recreation.
- Saat Roccia mendarat setelah melakukan Basic Attack Reality Recreation, ia meluncur ke udara dan mengaktifkan Beyond Imagination. Basic Attack Reality Recreation hanya tersedia dalam kondisi Beyond Imagination.
